name: Search
source:
Sampson has grown up in his home city of Octaves where flora and modern technology have merged together. In this city one can find whatever they could want, but Sampson doesn't know what he wants nor does he feel love for anything.

This story follows Sampson as he goes through the worst mental snowball of his life. Will he be able to get out of the cycle or will he succumb to it?

[From [url=https://xone101.itch.io/search]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
桑普森在他的家乡奥克塔夫长大，那里的植物与现代技术融为一体。在这座城市里，人们可以找到任何他们想要的东西，但桑普森不知道自己想要什么，也不喜欢任何东西。

这个故事讲述了桑普森经历了他一生中最糟糕的心理雪球。他能否摆脱这个循环，还是屈服于这个循环？

[来自[url=https://xone101.itch.io/search]Itch.io[/url]]
